infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ADA uses your location while planning journeys to calculate live commute times, find destinations, and preview departure schedules.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: ADA requires background location during active journey tracking to monitor your route progress, update ETA dynamically, and trigger approaching and arrival alerts even when the device is locked.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: ADA requires continuous location tracking during your active journey to alert you before your destination.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ADA does not require camera access.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow ADA to access your location in the background for active destination tracking.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow ADA to access your location while using the app.
